initialExam.title: PPSC PCS 2026 (Punjab Civil Service)
initialExam.description: Punjab Civil Service examination for recruitment to various administrative and allied services posts in the Punjab state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: General Studies, CSAT. Mains: Punjabi, English, Essay, General Studies Papers, Optional.
initialExam.jobRole: PCS Officer, DSP, ETO, Tehsildar in Punjab
initialExam.careerGrowth: PCS Officer → SDM → ADC → DC → Commissioner → Financial Commissioner.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ppsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Government quarters, Pension
